question: Why is warfarin sodium short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals
steps.purpose: Read on-hand stock and 28-day use where each hospital keeps it.
steps.finding: 4 stock lines across 3 hospitals, 3 presentations, in units of use.

steps.title: Where our supply is made
steps.purpose: Follow each product's label to the plants it names, and place each plant in FDA's registration file.
steps.finding: 2 plant links on 2 labels; 1 placed in FDA's registration file.

steps.title: What FDA says about this shortage
steps.purpose: Read FDA's current shortage list and its history for this drug.
steps.finding: Not on FDA's current shortage list.

steps.title: Who else makes it
steps.purpose: List every labeler of this drug in the same form, and the plants their labels name.
steps.finding: 19 labelers make it in this form.

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants
steps.purpose: Read every FDA drug inspection, warning letter, import alert and recall for these plants.
steps.finding: 17 inspections (1 OAI at our plants), 1 compliance actions, 0 import-alert listings, 0 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 1 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

explanation.headline: Warfarin sodium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; on-hand supply ranges from 18.8 to 26 days across sites

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include warfarin sodium as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 272 tablets of the 6 mg presentation, providing 26 days on hand at 10.5 tablets per day.
Corvale General holds 189 tablets of the 6 mg presentation, providing 18.8 days on hand at 10 tablets per day.
Corvale General also holds 266 tablets of the 2 mg presentation, providing 24.9 days on hand at 10.7 tablets per day.
The rule-ranked alternate manufacturer is Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.
Additional alternate manufacturers Coupler LLC and Exelan Pharmaceuticals Inc. are similarly not on the shortage list and have no placeable plant on their labels.
